name: is.polylist
title: A polylist is recognized. One polynomial is not.

origin.description: A polylist is recognized. One polynomial is not.
origin.value: The same value R returns for this call.

translation.description: A polylist is recognized. One polynomial is not.
translation.value: The same value R returns for this call.
translation.example:
from polynom import polylist, polynomial, is_polylist

def one():
    left = "TRUE" if is_polylist(polylist(1)) else "FALSE"
    right = "TRUE" if is_polylist(polynomial(1)) else "FALSE"
    return left + "," + right
print(one())
